newsitem.title: USA: HP cuts prices on ScanJet 4c & 4s.
newsitem.headline: HP cuts prices on ScanJet 4c & 4s.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co said Tuesday it has cut the list prices for its ScanJet 4c and 4s scanners.
The company announced U.S. list-price cuts for its ScanJet 4c and 4s scanners of 10 and 33 percent, respectively.
The ScanJet 4c color scanner list price will be cut to $1,069 from $1,179. Its retail price is expected to be $899.
The 4s grayscale scanner list price will be reduced to $239 from $369, and is expected to retail for $199.
Price changes for the 4c and 4s will take effect Sept. 1 and Aug. 1, respectively. The company said its strategy is to make scanners standard equipment for all business users.
